video_title: The Lakers' New Roster Was Built Around Luka | Rachel Nichols & Chris Mannix

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers' roster overhaul around Luka Doncic
quotes.excerpt: They have revamped the roster around Luka Doncic.
quotes.quote: Let's talk about a Western Conference team that maybe wins the East, maybe it wouldn't. The Los Angeles Lakers, now starting the Luka Doncic era in earnest. LeBron James is gone, Luka is there. I think they brought in 10 new pieces, including some of the rookies that are going to be on the roster. They have revamped the roster around Luka Doncic. They are all over in Slovenia, they are bonding, they are ready to go. Walker Kessler is back, played five games last year, but is here to backstop the defense. Sandro Mamukelashvili, he is manning the wings. Collin Sexton is there. They have a whole bunch of guys ready to play opposite Luka Doncic.

quotes.speaker: Rachel Nichols
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers' playoff outlook and defensive concerns
quotes.excerpt: I put them in the home court for the playoffs, so top four.

text_blocks.speaker: Rachel Nichols
text_blocks.text: I put them in the home court for the playoffs, so top four. And I think Luka Doncic is such an explosive player. When you have a guy who has shown under playoff pressure and playoff defense that he can go for 60, or I think higher, it could just not go your way with the scoring nights that he has. The concern I have for them, especially as they get deeper into the playoffs, is what we have talked about, the perimeter defense and I am not as good at that pronunciation, so I am not going to say it.

text_blocks.speaker: Rachel Nichols
text_blocks.text: I was going to say, I am just going to say Mamoo. Obviously you are fond of him for reasons of his last stop.

quotes.speaker: Rachel Nichols
quotes.summary_phrase: Marcus Smart's departure and Walker Kessler's defensive role
quotes.excerpt: Their best defender last year was Marcus Smart. And I mean just that's what the numbers say.
quotes.quote: Their best defender last year was Marcus Smart. And I mean just that's what the numbers say, and he is gone now. So you are asking new guys to step in, they missed out on Jonathan Kuminga. I think that Walker Kessler is going to be great blocking shots. His perimeter defense thus far has not been as strong, right? So either he can turn into a stronger perimeter defender or they are going to have problems there.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers' aggressive roster construction and future moves
quotes.excerpt: They went all in on this roster. They sign some guys to long deals, four-year deals.
quotes.quote: They went all in on this roster. They sign some guys to long deals, four-year deals. They give up multiple draft picks to get Walker Kessler. Like this is them going all in. And I have talked to people within the Lakers about this roster construction, and one thing I have been warned is like, hey, basically they were saying they are not done yet. They have got more that they want to do to build out the kind of roster they want to have opposite Luka Doncic.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic's MVP potential and offensive dominance
quotes.excerpt: You got to make Wembanyama the favorite for MVP for obvious reasons, but I think Luka is right there.
quotes.quote: Totally agree, Luka is going to have an outstanding year. I think Luka, you got to make Wembanyama the favorite for MVP for obvious reasons, but I think Luka is right there behind him. I think offensively, he is going to be outstanding. I think his conditioning this off-season has been exactly what it was last season. If you remember, the month of March, he was the best player in basketball. Down the stretch, Luka Doncic was playing the best basketball of the year. He looked like the MVP.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Defensive limitations of the Lakers' new roster
quotes.excerpt: The defensive concerns though of course are real. You have got Luka and Austin Reaves in the backcourt.
quotes.quote: The defensive concerns though of course are real. You have got Luka and Austin Reaves in the backcourt. They try sometimes, but they are not elite defensive players. Grimes, the Ravia, not elite defensive players. It does put a ton of pressure on Walker Kessler to number one stay healthy, to be out there on the floor and number two to backstop that team defensively, block shots, defensive rebound, be a little bit of everything. He is going to have to be like Walker Mutumbo back there sometimes, cleaning up the glass. And backing up Walker Kessler right now is Kevon Looney. 10 years ago, would have loved that. I love Kevon Looney, but 2026-27 Kevon Looney, I don't know.

quotes.speaker: Rachel Nichols
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic's defensive effort and MVP candidacy
quotes.excerpt: I have sat for years when he was on the Dallas Mavericks, defending his defense to you.
quotes.quote: I have sat for years when he was on the Dallas Mavericks, defending his defense to you, because I think when he is wants to play defense, when he wants to exert himself on that side, he is so much better than his reputation. Last season, he had stretches where he did not show as much interest in playing defense, being on that side of the floor as he did on the offensive side of the floor. That is just a fact.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers' defensive depth and potential lineup adjustments
quotes.excerpt: Maybe you are going to have to sacrifice some offense playing some of these guys to be sharper defensively.
quotes.quote: They have got Matisse Thybulle, who is an excellent defender. They have got Jared Vanderbilt, who is a Swiss Army knife type of defender. Maybe you are going to have to sacrifice some offense playing some of these guys to be sharper defensively against especially teams with elite perimeter players, which is really the top two teams in the Western Conference, because Stephen Curry and Dillon Brooks, they are not going anywhere. Oklahoma City still has dogs led by the MVP. Maybe you have to start putting more defensive-minded lineups out there and go deeper into your bench.
